temperaments.label: Wary
temperaments.story: Flinches at every hand and watches before it trusts.

lines.Sealed: It stays at the edge of the party, eyes down.
lines.Wary: It lets a teammate sit close for the first time.
lines.Thawing: It follows you without being called.
lines.Opening: It takes a berry from your hand.
lines.purified: The haze lifts. It leans against you, shaking, then steady.

temperaments.label: Proud
temperaments.story: Eager to prove its strength, and angry that it was ever made to hide it.

lines.Sealed: It snaps at the air, daring anyone to pity it.
lines.Wary: It nods once after a win. That is all.
lines.Thawing: It stands between you and the next foe unasked.
lines.Opening: It shows you the move it was ashamed of.
lines.purified: The haze lifts. It stands tall and, for the first time, fights for itself.

temperaments.label: Gentle
temperaments.story: Still kind under the haze, and quick to forgive.

lines.Sealed: It tilts its head, as if trying to remember something warm.
lines.Wary: It nuzzles a teammate and looks surprised at itself.
lines.Thawing: It hums while the party rests.
lines.Opening: It brings you a flower from the roadside.
lines.purified: The haze lifts. It is purified, and it remembers every kindness.

temperaments.label: Stubborn
temperaments.story: Distrusts everyone, and will take its time deciding you are the exception.

lines.Sealed: It turns its back and will not eat.
lines.Wary: It stops flinching when you reach into the bag.
lines.Thawing: It stays awake on watch while you sleep.
lines.Opening: It finally answers when you call its name.
lines.purified: The haze lifts. It looks at you a long time, then falls into step beside you.

temperaments.label: Restless
temperaments.story: Always moving, as if the haze might catch it if it ever stopped.

lines.Sealed: It paces and will not settle.
lines.Wary: It rests, once, with one eye open.
lines.Thawing: It races ahead and doubles back to check on you.
lines.Opening: It falls asleep mid-stride and does not mind.
lines.purified: The haze lifts. It runs a full lap of camp, laughing.

factions.name: Umbra Corps
factions.aim: Close Pokémon hearts in a lab and sell them as unstoppable fighters.

lieutenant.name: Dr. Vesper
lieutenant.intro: Dr. Vesper adjusts a glove. "Subject recovered, I see. How careless of them to lose it."
lieutenant.returns: Dr. Vesper is back with a fresh team. "You cost me a clean prototype last time. I kept the notes."

factions.expands: Umbra Corps opens more labs and ships more Shadow Pokémon.
factions.retaliates: Umbra Corps sends hunters after the Pokémon you freed.

factions.name: Gilded Talon
factions.aim: Poach rare Pokémon and hand the strongest to a lab for the Shadow process.

lieutenant.name: Captain Rook
lieutenant.intro: Captain Rook cracks a whip against a crate. "Pretty team. Pity about the cages."
lieutenant.returns: Captain Rook returns with armoured handlers. "Third time lucky. This crate is bolted shut."

factions.expands: Gilded Talon poaches more routes and fills more cages.
factions.retaliates: Gilded Talon raids a quiet place to replace what it lost.

blessings.name: Hearth Blessing
blessings.text: A warm calm settles over the party. It takes 15% less damage for the next 3 battles.

blessings.name: Bloom Blessing
blessings.text: Soft light mends the team after each of the next 3 battles.

blessings.name: Clarity Blessing
blessings.text: A clear head: status conditions on your side wear off sooner for the next 2 battles.

blessings.name: Wild Grace
blessings.text: Wild Pokémon are calmer and easier to befriend for the next 3 wild encounters.
